title: Juicy Sweet Croatian Pork Skewers
description: Sweet and springy Croatian dish featuring piccalilli, perfect for a date night, with caramelized pork and no onions or garlic
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pork is caramelized and cooked through.
While the pork is cooking, heat the piccalilli in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the pork is done, brush the heated piccalilli onto the skewers.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
